title: A Logarithmic Spiral Formed by a Sequence of Regular Polygons
summary: When the sequence of regular polygons with consecutively increasing numbers of sides is joined edge-to-edge in a single direction while minimizing bending, the resulting structure assumes the shape of a logarithmic spiral. This paper proves that this spiral takes the form r=exp(4θ/π). Specifically, it is derived that the distances between the curve and the centers of the even-sided and odd-sided regular polygons converge to 5/6 and 7/12, respectively, with the centers extending outward along the inner side of the spiral.
